dataset: IO-VNBD synchronized phone/VBOX pairs, converted by tools/iovnbd_to_contract.py
input_description: VBOX vehicle-frame yaw rate and acceleration (external IMU) + VBOX GNSS 1 Hz
gnss_aiding: VBOX receiver fixes at 1 Hz (phone GPS was logged only every ~9 s)
calibration: batch mount calibration from the drive's warm-up window (phone IMU + GNSS aiding stream, no truth), released at the window end
engine: app CalibratingFusionEngine + FusionNavigationEngine via edge runIovnbdEval, IO-VNBD rest/straightness profile
pass_gate: drift < 10 % of distance travelled during the outage
